title: Meta readies two prescription-supported Ray-Ban AI glasses, set to launch next week: Report | Mint
summary: Meta is launching two new Ray-Ban smart glasses with prescription support, competing with Apple's upcoming non-AR smart glasses and OpenAI's potential smart glasses. Additionally, Meta is developing a smartwatch with health tracking and a built-in AI assistant, while facing challenges in its Reality Labs division.
sentiment_reason: The introduction of prescription Ray-Ban smart glasses and the development of new AI-powered products are positive for Meta, indicating growth and innovation in the smart glasses market.
